critical_code_review_comments: CR-083 implementation is complete and well-structured
Split button visibility logic (line 286-294) correctly checks for amount > 0
Split validation (line 631-645) properly validates sum matches total and all rows have method/amount
flatMap expansion (line 651-668) correctly expands split lines into multiple API detail entries
Cash Draw balance hint (line 391-396) shows available balance and insufficient warning
Unpaid tracking warning (line 398-402) correctly displays 'Will be tracked as outstanding'
Cancel split (line 574-581) properly restores first split row's method
Remove split row (line 604-614) correctly unsplits when only 1 row remains
All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
